notes: Anchors T (ideal, utility 100) and L (unacceptable, utility 0) are team proposals; anchor_basis says where each comes from. Within-dimension weights follow the teammate proposal and are to be confirmed by swing weighting.

wildfire_bp_national_percentile.label: Wildfire burn-probability national percentile
wildfire_bp_national_percentile.anchor_basis: Natural end points of a national percentile

inland_flood_loss_rate_percentile.label: Inland flood expected-loss-rate national percentile
inland_flood_loss_rate_percentile.anchor_basis: Natural end points of a national percentile

baseline_water_stress.label: Baseline water stress (Aqueduct 4.0)
baseline_water_stress.anchor_basis: Aqueduct categories: < 1 low (< 10% withdrawal/supply); >= 4 extremely high (> 80%)

low_impervious_land_share.label: Share of land with < 10% impervious cover
low_impervious_land_share.anchor_basis: Team assumption: 95% open land is ample; below 25% (dense urban core) no room for a campus. Direction to be confirmed

gap12_protected_land_share.label: GAP 1/2 protected land share
gap12_protected_land_share.anchor_basis: Team assumption: half of a county under strict protection is the limit (observed max 0.41)

wetland_land_share.label: Wetland share of land
wetland_land_share.anchor_basis: Just above the observed maximum (0.58) so no county is zeroed by this indicator alone

fiber_business_1000_100_availability.label: Business fiber availability at 1000/100 Mbps
fiber_business_1000_100_availability.anchor_basis: Team assumption: coverage of 90% or more counts as saturated

labor_force.label: Civilian labor force
labor_force.anchor_basis: Log scale so large metros do not win automatically; 50,000 workers counts as ample, under 2,000 as too thin. Anchors are in persons and log-transformed with the value

distance_to_interstate_km.label: Distance to nearest Interstate
distance_to_interstate_km.anchor_basis: Within 5 km is as good as adjacent; 60 km is about the 90th percentile

distance_to_rail_km.label: Distance to nearest rail line
distance_to_rail_km.anchor_basis: Within 2 km allows a spur; 30 km is above the 90th percentile

state_industrial_price.label: State industrial electricity price
state_industrial_price.anchor_basis: Approximate range of US state industrial prices

state_ieee_saidi_without_med.label: State SAIDI excluding major events
state_ieee_saidi_without_med.anchor_basis: Approximate range of US utility SAIDI

water_stress_change_2050.label: Change in water stress, 2050 BAU minus baseline (Aqueduct index points)
water_stress_change_2050.basis: Half of one Aqueduct category width; team assumption

fiber_100_20_availability.label: Business fiber availability at 100/20 Mbps (context; overlaps the scored 1000/100 indicator)

social_vulnerability.label: CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index percentile (community-impact context, not scored)

extreme_heat_days.label: Days per year above 90 F (cooling-design risk; overlaps the scored CDD indicator)
extreme_heat_days.basis: Team assumption: about two weeks, six weeks and ten weeks of 90 F days
